tess: quick postmortem follow-up — last night's OOM on c64-batch. short summary: shard residency didn't drop after client reconnects; small-slab fragmentation rose.

omar: pls paste the short action list so i can schedule infra window.

dave: datapoints: jemalloc.retained/rss ~1.13, kv_res_count +20% over 2h. uploaded heap diff to perf bucket.

tess: actions:
- 1) jemalloc arena dumps + cross-canary heap scans — owner: @dave — due: 2026-06-05
- 2) staging config: per-shard idle-evict 20m (config-only) — owner: @omar — due: 2026-06-04
- 3) low-prio slab/kv compactor behind flag (token-bucket cap) — owner: @tess — due: 2026-06-18
- 4) add metric kv_fragmentation_ratio + alert >12%/3h — owner: @runbooks — due: 2026-06-03
- 5) quick stream-drain patch to drop watcher refs (fast fix) — owner: @omar — due: 2026-06-06

dave: started 1) — uploading to gs://redwood-perf/oom/3123456789/ now; will attach flamegraphs.

eng-bot: deploy-notice: staging config change scheduled 2026-06-04 02:00 UTC by omar. CI: green. :robot_face: 

tess: rollout note: config-only canary first (10%); compactor behind flag and canary at 5% if enabled. rollback if p95 > baseline+25ms or error-rate spike.

runbooks: updated "kv-residency" runbook with steps to run 1), flip idle-evict, and escalation template. heuristic: if jemalloc.retained / rss > 1.08 -> fragmentation-first.

omar: will run staging validation and post graphs here. ack.

tess: reconvene Tue 2026-06-08 16:00 UTC (30m) for status. update when tasks complete or blockers appear. :white_check_mark:
